instructions.notes: Notes: Heights are approximate. Confirm in slicer before printing.
instructions.title: 3D Print Instructions
instructions.flatFaceUp: Flat Paint mode (face-up, no clear layer):
instructions.flatFaceDown: Flat Paint mode (face-down with clear carrier):
instructions.export3mf: - Export as 3MF: the model contains one object per filament.
instructions.assignFilaments: - Assign each object to its filament in the slicer (multi-material printer required).
instructions.faceUp: - Print as-is and face-up. Do not mirror the model in the slicer.
instructions.topSurface: - The artwork is exposed on the top surface.
instructions.clearCarrier: - Use clear/transparent filament for the carrier object — it is the first printed layer and becomes the smooth viewing face.
instructions.faceDown: - Print as-is: the artwork is already mirrored for face-down printing. Do not mirror in the slicer.
instructions.flip: - After printing, flip the piece over: the image side is the bottom.
instructions.noSwaps: - No swaps — only one color configured.
instructions.reinforcement: Reinforcement grid: {{count}} layer(s) above the first layer
instructions.couponOrientation: - Keep the coupon face-up and at 100% scale.
instructions.confirmMaterials: - Confirm every 3MF layer part is assigned to the matching physical filament.
instructions.orientationMarker: - The missing corner is the top-left marker in the Kromacut patch map.
instructions.targetScreenOnly: - The target color row is screen-only and is not printed.
instructions.reinforcementMargins: - Reinforcement occupies only margins and trenches; sample squares keep their exact stacks.
instructions.joinedCells: - Touching active cells are joined per layer; every sample keeps its exact stack height.
instructions.proofSwap: {{step}}. Change to {{color}} ({{id}}) before layer {{layer}} at Z {{height}} mm.
instructions.viewTop: View the printed top surface under the lighting used for normal evaluation.
